create_object_dataloader: create an Object dataloader instance from a dataset path to load object pose ground truth data
create_object_dataloader_no_data: create an Object dataloader without a dataset path to initialize identity poses for 180 seconds at 30 fps
add_noise_to_poses: add random translation and rotation noise to object poses using a noise configuration object
save_baseline_poses: save the tracked object poses as a baseline pickle file to the original dataset path
review_object_class: review the Object class and understand how map_mode controls initialization with ground truth versus identity poses
